nodes.summary: Chargebee is a comprehensive subscription management and recurring billing platform that enables businesses to automate their billing processes, manage customer churn, and experiment with pricing strategies. It offers a range of features including usage-based pricing, payment retries and collections, and revenue recognition. It also provides robust reporting and analytics capabilities, and integrates with multiple payment gateways.

nodes.name: Subscription Management
nodes.description: Allows businesses to manage and automate their subscription billing processes.

nodes.name: Usage-based Pricing
nodes.description: Enables businesses to implement and manage usage-based pricing models.

nodes.name: Payment Retries and Collections
nodes.description: Automates the process of retrying failed payments and managing collections.

nodes.name: Revenue Recognition
nodes.description: Helps businesses recognize revenue accurately and ensures GAAP-compliance and audit readiness.

nodes.name: Reporting and Analytics
nodes.description: Provides robust reporting and analytics capabilities to help businesses make data-driven decisions.

nodes.name: Customer Retention
nodes.description: Predicts churn, deflects cancellation attempts, and helps grow customer lifetime value.
